title: Military pay, allowances, retirement and VA compensation reference (FY2025, with 2026 deltas)
money_rule: All money is integer cents (premise P8). Source values given only to the whole dollar are marked rounded=true and must not be shown as cent-accurate. No kernel may read a rate whose status is ILLUSTRATIVE or HEURISTIC, and no missing cell is interpolated.

va_compensation.superseded_by_note: VA rates rose 2.8% effective 2025-12-01; the source gives only the 100% single 2026 figure. The v2.0 build's 133-row 2026 table is described in the project but its data is not in hand.
va_compensation.with_spouse_and_one_child_missing: 40, 60, 80, 90 are not in the source. Do not cascade or interpolate; report the cell as unavailable.

rate_2026_points.note: 2.8% COLA. Only this cell is given by the source.

tdiu.rule_text: Paid at the 100% schedular rate when service-connected conditions prevent substantially gainful employment and the veteran has one condition rated 60% or more, or a combined 70% or more with at least one condition at 40% (38 CFR 4.16(a)).
tdiu.note: The rating kernel's TDIU threshold check is PLANNED in this repo; the v2.0 build had it. Marginal-employment threshold cited by the source: about $14,580 (2025), approximate.

smc_2025_approximate.note: Source gives these with '~'. Shown for orientation only; never computed with.

permanent_and_total_unlocks: Chapter 35 DEA education (source: about $1,574/month full-time, Oct 2025–Sep 2026)
State property tax exemptions (state-dependent; see state_benefits)
VA home loan funding fee waived
DIC eligibility for a surviving spouse if rated 100% for 8+ continuous years before death

military_pay.note: 4.5% across-the-board raise effective 2025-01-01, plus about 10% targeted raise for E-1 to E-4 effective 2025-04-01. Selected longevity gates only, rounded to the dollar. 2026: +3.8% effective 2026-01-01 (no table in source).

row_notes.O-9/O-10: Capped at the Level II Executive Schedule.

bas.note: From the source's own caveats section.

bah_samples_2025.note: Illustrative with-dependents midpoints. The DTMO lookup by ZIP and grade is authoritative. National BAH rose about 5.4% in 2025 and about 4.2% in 2026. BAH is rate-protected during an assignment and ends on the separation date with no taper.

rows.note: Source says 'Fort Novosel area'; Fort Novosel was redesignated Fort Rucker on 2025-06-11.

bah_samples_2025.dedupe_note: The Gen-3 client's four BAH tiers (1572 / 1899 / 3966 / 4260) are this table's E-7 Enterprise, E-7 Huntsville and E-7 San Diego cells plus an O-3 Honolulu-range value. They are not a separate dataset and are not carried.

systems.name: High-3 (legacy)
systems.base: average of highest 36 months of base pay
systems.eligibility: Entered service 1980-09-08 to 2017-12-31 and did not opt into BRS; 20 years of service.

systems.name: Blended Retirement System
systems.base: average of highest 36 months of base pay
systems.eligibility: Entered 2018-01-01 or later, or opted in during 2018.
systems.tsp: 1% automatic after 60 days; matching begins at 2 years; up to 5% government total; vests at 2 years.
systems.continuation_pay: Between 8 and 12 years of service for an added 4-year commitment; 2.5–13x monthly base pay (active), 0.5–6x (reserve); taxable.
systems.lump_sum: 25% or 50% of discounted present value of pension before full Social Security age; pension reduced until then.

systems.name: REDUX / Career Status Bonus (legacy)
systems.note: Multiplier reduced 1 point per year under 30; COLA CPI minus 1% until age 62.

systems.name: Disability retirement (Chapter 61), TDRL / PDRL
systems.note: Service rating 30%+ may retire before 20 years. Pay is the greater of years x multiplier x High-3 or service rating x High-3, capped at 75%. TDRL up to 3 years before PDRL or separation.

systems.name: Guard / Reserve retirement
systems.note: 50 points per good year (15 membership + 35 drill); 20 good years. Pay usually starts at 60, reduced by 90 days for each 90 days of qualifying active duty after 2008-01-28 (not below 50). Formula: points / 360 x multiplier x High-3.

concurrent_receipt.name: CRDP
concurrent_receipt.note: 20+ years (or qualifying TERA/Reserve at 60) and VA rating 50%+; automatic; restores full retired pay; taxable.

concurrent_receipt.name: CRSC
concurrent_receipt.note: Combat-related disability, any rating; tax-free; apply with DD Form 2860 to the parent service. CRDP or CRSC, chosen annually (typically January), never both.

sbp.dic_offset: Eliminated January 2023; survivors may receive full SBP and full DIC.

retirement_systems.tera_example_note: TERA reduces the multiplier about 1% per year short of 20 (persona example in the source).

income_replacement_heuristics.note: Rule-of-thumb gross-up multipliers (35–40% low-cost, 55–65% high-cost; 1.35–1.40x base pay) are widely used but not DoD-published. The architecture of record already dropped the unsourced 1.385 gross-up factor ('documented, never applied'); these follow the same rule. Use the Greenbook RMC tables as system-of-record input.
income_replacement_heuristics.formula_documented: Civilian gross needed = base x 12 + (BAH + BAS) x 12 x tax multiplier + special pays + TRICARE replacement + TSP match loss + state tax adjustment; tax multiplier = 1 / (1 - marginal effective rate).

separation_cliff_items.note: What ends at separation, with typical monthly values from the source. For the financial-transition explainer only; never presented as the user's number.
